description:
O desafio consiste em contar a história dos equipamentos e veículos espaciais enviados pela NASA à Lua e a Marte que, após cumprirem suas missões, permaneceram nesses locais.

A proposta é desenvolver um projeto educativo e interativo para mostrar às pessoas:

Quais equipamentos foram enviados ao espaço.

Qual era a função de cada um.

O que eles descobriram durante suas missões.

Por que foram deixados na Lua ou em Marte.

Qual foi sua contribuição para a exploração espacial.
summary:
Stellar Legacy is an educational card collection inspired by real NASA space missions, developed to transform scientific knowledge into a playful, interactive, and accessible learning experience. The project presents the stories of spacecraft, probes, satellites, and space equipment, highlighting their discoveries, technologies, challenges, and destinations.

Through cards featuring information, fun facts, multiple-choice questions, and explanations of the answers, we aim to bring children and young people closer to the history of space exploration, using the dynamics of traditional card games as a learning tool.

The project addresses the challenge “Abandoned but Not Forgotten” by bringing attention to the importance of space equipment and missions that have left their mark on the Moon, Mars, and human history. Its importance lies in preserving this scientific legacy, sparking curiosity, encouraging learning, and demonstrating that even completed missions continue to contribute to the advancement of science and technology.
details:
Stellar Legacy is an educational card collection that transforms the history of NASA space missions into an interactive learning experience. Each card presents a real mission, its launch date, purpose, discoveries, interesting facts, and multiple-choice questions, accompanied by answers and explanations. The concept uses the dynamics of traditional card games to spark interest in science and space exploration.

Its main benefits include encouraging curiosity, developing scientific knowledge and critical thinking, and making learning fun and engaging. Our intended impact is to bring children and young people closer to the history of space exploration, showing that equipment and missions that may seem forgotten continue to leave an important legacy for humanity.

The creative aspect lies in transforming scientific information into an educational, accessible, and collectible game. When selecting the missions, we considered the relevance of scientific discoveries, the technologies developed, remarkable stories, and the final destination of the equipment. We also prioritized accessible language, visual appeal, and the possibility of reaching different age groups.

The development process involved researching official NASA sources, organizing information, and creating the visual design and structure of the cards. The presented project does not specify the programming languages, hardware, or software used.
